text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicant whose parents or one of his/her parents are Chinese, he/she must hold a valid non-Chinese passport or Certificate of Nationality for no less than 4 years. Additionally, applicant shall submit records of living out of China for more than 2 years in the last 4 years (up to April 30 of the year of enrolment). *9 months of living abroad within a year can be counted as 1 year, subject to the entry and exit stamps. 2. Applicant must be between 18 to 30 years old (on the date of enrolment). 3. Applicant must meet the health requirements issued by the Chinese Ministry of Education and the Chinese Ministry of Health. 4. For some country's applicants who need to serve the army, we suggest you complete your duty before applying. 5. If applicants have a history of expulsion, we will refuse the application. 6. Applicant who has criminal or prison records will not be accepted. 7. The minimum score of TOEFL is 85, the minimum score of IELTS is 6.5.
